reference.title: Pharmacokinetics of caffeine in plasma and saliva, and the influence of caffeine abstinence on CYP1A2 metrics.
reference.journal: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
reference.abstract: The saliva paraxanthine/caffeine concentration ratio at 4h was a suitable metric to assess CYP1A2 activity after oral administration of caffeine without the need for 24-h caffeine abstinence.
